bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money to the Rochester Area Foundation for the Pamoja Women program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; ROCHESTER AREA FOUNDATION PAMOJA WOMEN PROGRAM. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to the Rochester Area Foundation for the Pamoja Women program to provide after school enrichment and to partner with a food bank to stock culturally specific foods. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money to the Rochester Area Foundation for the Pamoja Women program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ROCHESTER AREA FOUNDATION PAMOJA WOMEN PROGRAM.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to the Rochester Area Foundation for the Pamoja Women program to provide after school enrichment and to partner with a food bank to stock culturally specific foods. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
